company_name: SY Holdings Group Limited (formerly Sheng Ye Capital)
model: Lender FCFE (distributable earnings) capitalisation at cost of equity (engine route)

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: revenue 5-year CAGR 7.3% (FY2020-FY2025) haircut for the continuing run-off of digital financing income (RMB722.8m FY2023 -> 375.9m FY2025, -28% YoY) only partly offset by platform revenue (+36.6% FY2025); H1 FY2026 revenue +1.0%, attributable profit +4.4%
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3-year CAGR 3.7% diverges >30% from EPS/net-income 3-year CAGR 29.7%. The EPS figure rebounds off the depressed FY2022 base (RMB0.22, when finance costs doubled); equity is flat because FY2025 dividends paid (RMB950.6m incl. specials) exceeded profit and were funded by book shrinkage plus RMB735m of placements. Neither CAGR is a usable forward rate; 5% is selected.
historical_growth.notes: fcf_*_cagr are computed on attributable net income (the FCFE proxy for this model: 219.4 -> 478.9 over 3 years, 329.3 -> 478.9 over 5), NOT on reported FCF, which is loan-book noise (-797m FY2022, +2,656m FY2024, +1,692m FY2025). Owner-FCF adjustments (SBC 2.5-12.9m/yr, interest income 3-34m/yr) are immaterial against those swings and do not change the conclusion that reported FCF cannot be used as a base.

scenario_narratives.base: The asset-light pivot continues at its current pace: platform-based technology revenue (52% of FY2025 revenue, +36.6%) grows low-20s% while on-balance-sheet digital financing income runs off ~15-20%/yr, so group revenue is flat-to-+2% in FY2026 (H1 +1.0%) and re-accelerates to 5-6% as the fee line dominates. Finance costs keep falling with the own-book and funding cost (6.1% -> 5.0%), offsetting rising staff/R&D spend, so the PBT-basis margin holds ~72.5%. Earnings compound mid-single digits, 90% is distributed (the FY2024-FY2026 payout commitment), and the stock remains a ~7-8% yield with modest growth.
scenario_narratives.bull: E-commerce, Southeast Asia and AI services all scale: e-commerce cumulative volume already went from RMB6bn to >RMB10bn in six months with six platform integrations and Be Friends as a strategic holder; the Singapore HQ with Temasek support replicates the model offshore; AI service revenue (RMB17m -> RMB21.5m in a half) becomes a high-margin line. Group revenue grows 9-11% in FY2027-FY2029, associates' profit keeps compounding, margin reaches 75%, and with the own-book shrinking almost all earnings are distributable. The market re-rates from 12x to a mid-teens multiple.
scenario_narratives.bear: Regulation bites: Yinfa No. 77 [2025] and the disguised-lending / e-IOU crackdowns raise compliance cost and constrain facilitation and credit-enhancement fees, while a China SME credit downturn lifts impairments on the RMB4.4bn FVTOCI book and a top-tier core-enterprise relationship is lost. Revenue falls 3%/yr for two years, margin compresses to 62%, and after the FY2026 payout commitment lapses management retains 20% of earnings as capital for the factoring/guarantee entities. The overseas, AI and RWA/stablecoin initiatives carry opex and regulatory headline risk without material revenue.

valuation_philosophy.summary: SY is valued as a lender becoming a fee platform: distributable earnings to ordinary shareholders (attributable NPAT less capital retained for the credit-enhancement entities), capitalised at a 12% CNY cost of equity with no net-debt bridge, converted to HKD at spot. The headline question is whether the fee line grows fast enough to offset the run-off of balance-sheet financing income; the model answers that in the revenue path, and the regulatory and credit risk sits in the scenario weights rather than in a stacked discount-rate premium.
key_risks_to_valuation: Regulatory: Yinfa No. 77 [2025] and disguised-lending / electronic-IOU crackdowns could constrain facilitation fees or require more capital in the factoring and guarantee entities (bear case).
Mix-shift arithmetic: digital financing income fell 28% in FY2025; if platform revenue growth slows below ~20% group revenue shrinks (bear).
Credit: RMB4.36bn of supply-chain assets at FVTOCI remain on balance sheet with core-enterprise concentration in infrastructure, pharma and commodities.

Payout sustainability: the >=90% commitment ends FY2026; FY2025 dividends (RMB950.6m paid) exceeded profit and were funded by book shrinkage and RMB735m of placements -- more placements would dilute the flat share count assumed here.
FX: CNY flows against an HKD quote; the 1.1748 rate must be refreshed with the price.
The 'EBITDA margin' in this file is a PBT-basis margin after finance costs and associates; do not read it as an operating margin or compare it with operating-company multiples.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (HKEX regular close); 52-week range 5.30-12.36; CNY/HKD from Yahoo CNYHKD=X same date
data_sources.financials: 6069.HK_Metrics.csv / core_metrics (RMB millions); FY2025 annual report (P&L, tax note 11, dividend), H1 FY2026 interim report (balance sheet at 30 June 2026, share capital note 24, EPS note 12, taxation paragraph); kpis table for segment revenue, finance costs, associates and dividends
data_sources.qualitative: 6069.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-24): business model, mix-shift, regulatory risk, guidance (payout >=90% FY2024-FY2026, no numeric revenue guidance), interim outlook section

inputs.share_count_basis: 1,066,275,792 issued at 30 June 2026 less 521,000 treasury shares = 1,065,754,792, plus 1,430k dilutive options/RSUs from the H1 FY2026 diluted EPS table = 1,067.2m. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows. The Metrics.csv figure of 1,055.2m is the H1 FY2026 diluted weighted average, which lags the May and September 2025 placements (73.8m new shares). Options at HK$8.09 (5m, June 2026) and HK$12.88 are out of the money at the current price.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash flow statement, 'Equity-settled share-based payments expense' RMB2,472k (6069.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:4364); no separate equity-award tax line (net-share settlement not used). Kept in the flows at 0.3% of revenue.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in RMB (CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. Values computed in CNY per share and converted at CNY/HKD 1.1748 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-24). No dual listing exists for a parity check; direction verified by magnitude: FY2025 EPS RMB0.48 x 1.1748 = HK$0.56, and 6.75 / 0.56 = 12.0x trailing P/E, consistent with the H-share fintech peer range. refresh_price.py moves the price but not this rate; re-derive the rate on any later refresh.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of equity 12.0% built in CNY: 10-year CGB ~1.8% risk-free, China equity risk premium ~7%, beta >1 for a wholesale-funded small-cap non-bank lender (HK$7.2bn market cap), plus a size/liquidity and regulatory-regime premium (PBOC-led Yinfa No. 77 [2025] on supply-chain-finance information providers, rated high severity in the Analysis). Folder precedent for large SOE Chinese banks is 10.5-11%; SY is smaller, non-deposit-funded and under a less settled regulatory regime. The same rate is used in all three scenarios -- risk is charged once, in the flows (owner-fcf-adaptations section f). The sensitivity grid spans 10-14%.
inputs.lease_treatment: Leases are immaterial (lease liabilities RMB13.1m at 30 June 2026; principal + interest RMB11.1m/yr). Treatment (B): the lease charge sits inside the PBT-based margin (depreciation of ROU assets and lease interest are both above PBT), and lease liabilities are excluded from the bridge, which holds net debt at zero anyway.
inputs.nci_treatment: Attributable-only flows: the 27% 'cash tax' path blends the 25.6-26.3% effective tax rate with ~1% NCI leakage (NCI profit RMB4.3m FY2025, RMB2.5m H1 FY2026 on NCI equity of RMB46.3m). FY0 NOPAT ties to reported attributable net income of RMB478.9m: (649.6 x (1 - 0.263)) = 478.9. No NCI deduction in the bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: Lender FCFE (distributable earnings) capitalised at cost of equity, run through the component engine. Routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md -- SY is a wholesale-funded supply-chain lender (RMB4.36bn supply-chain assets at FVTOCI, RMB4.2bn borrowings and related-party loans at 30 June 2026) transitioning to fee-based loan facilitation, so an owner-FCF DCF is meaningless here: operating cash flow swings with the loan book (-RMB1,049m FY2018 to +RMB2,760m FY2024, +RMB1,381m H1 FY2026) and the borrowings are operating funding, not net debt. ENGINE MAPPING: 'revenue' = revenue and income from principal activities (platform technology services + digital financing income + refinancing gains); 'EBITDA margin' = (profit before tax + D&A + SBC) / revenue, i.e. AFTER finance costs, impairments, other income/gains and share of associates' profit, which is why it reads 73-76% rather than an operating-company level (FY2023 42.3%, FY2024 60.8%, FY2025 76.4%, H1 FY2026 73.6%; the expansion came from finance costs falling RMB409m -> 243m as the own-book shrank and funding cost fell 6.1% -> 5.0%, and associates' profit rising RMB20m -> 151m); 'cash tax rate' 27% = effective tax + NCI leakage so NOPAT = attributable net income; 'capex' = D&A (maintenance, ~4% of revenue; the FY2025 reported capex of RMB512m is dominated by the Wuxi office build later transferred to investment property / properties for sale and is not recurring) PLUS the capital retained to support the guarantee and credit-enhancement entities -- 10% of NOPAT in base (the >=90% payout commitment for FY2024-FY2026), 5% in bull (asset-light succeeds, book keeps shrinking), 20% in bear (credit losses and regulatory capital absorb earnings). The resulting 'owner FCF' is therefore distributable earnings to ordinary shareholders, discounted at the cost of equity with net debt = 0; the engine's street basis adds back only the 0.3% SBC charge, so house and street nearly coincide. last_fcf 431.0 = FY2025 attributable NPAT 478.9 x 0.90, the FY0 distributable figure on the same definition; reported_fcf is the company's OCF less capex and is not used. interest_income is 0 because the RMB27m bank interest (inside other income) stays in the flows and no cash is added to the bridge. BALANCE-SHEET VINTAGE: 30 June 2026 interim -- cash RMB999.3m, pledged deposits RMB1,193.9m, borrowings RMB2,672.1m, loans from related parties RMB1,533.9m, equity attributable RMB3,893.0m. The FY2025 final dividend (RMB0.4047) and special dividend (RMB0.2319), about RMB679m in total, were paid AFTER 30 June 2026 (final paid 17 Aug 2026; dividends paid in H1 FY2026 were nil), so pro forma equity is ~RMB3.2bn and the current price is ex both; nothing is added to the bridge for the cash because the model values forward distributable earnings, not the balance sheet. Price is a regular HKEX close, not after-hours. SBC-light market: SBC is 0.3% of revenue, so the house/street band is a sliver. No prior DCF exists; fresh build, no reconciliation block.

bear.capex_note: D&A + 8.0% of revenue retention = ~20% of NOPAT; credit losses and regulatory capital for the factoring/guarantee entities absorb earnings and the payout drops after the FY2026 commitment lapses
bear.narrative: Yinfa No. 77 and the crackdown on disguised lending / electronic-IOU platforms raise compliance cost and cap facilitation fees; digital financing income keeps shrinking faster than platform revenue replaces it, so revenue falls 3%/yr for two years. A China SME credit downturn lifts impairments on the RMB4.4bn own-book and a core-enterprise relationship is lost; PBT margin compresses to 62%. The overseas/AI/RWA bets consume opex without revenue. 20% of earnings retained as capital.

base.capex_note: D&A (maintenance) + 5.0% of revenue capital retention = ~10% of NOPAT, the complement of the >=90% payout commitment
base.narrative: FY2026 revenue +2% (H1 +1.0%); platform technology revenue keeps growing low-20s% while digital financing income declines ~15-20%/yr, so group revenue re-accelerates to 5-6% in FY2027-FY2029 as the fee line becomes two-thirds of the mix, then fades to 2.5%. Margin (PBT basis) holds ~72.5%: finance costs keep falling with the own-book but platform revenue carries rising staff/R&D cost (H1 FY2026 staff +33%). Tax + NCI 27%. 10% of earnings retained.

bull.capex_note: D&A + 2.5% of revenue retention = ~5% of NOPAT; asset-light model needs little incremental capital
bull.narrative: E-commerce supply-chain finance (cumulative volume RMB6bn -> >RMB10bn in six months), Southeast Asia via the Singapore HQ and Temasek, and AI value-added services each scale; platform revenue compounds 30%+ and group revenue grows 9-11% in FY2027-FY2029 despite the financing run-off. Fee revenue and associates' profit lift the PBT margin to 75%; the book keeps shrinking so 95% of earnings are distributable.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 30%: the Analysis rates China supply-chain-finance regulatory tightening (Yinfa No. 77 [2025]) as high severity and the thesis rests on an unproven pivot -- the legacy lending line is shrinking 28%/yr and the replacement engines (e-commerce, overseas, AI, RWA) are still small in absolute terms. Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent initiatives to land together and a re-rating of a thinly-covered HK small-cap. Base 50%: the mix-shift is already visible in reported numbers (platform revenue 8.7% -> 52% of revenue in four years) and the company has 12 profitable years and an 8-year dividend record.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
